content: In terms of performance, the most intensive I tested was CONTROL and some of the recent Resident Evil games. At 1080p and even 1440p I had no issues with high settings at 60fps, they perform well. But it’s just so easy to tweak resolution “let see how this does” that you see the bottleneck right away, it’s the GPU, not RAM. For most past forget about any Raytracing, it works but you probably have to go for lower settings/lower res which is not ideal. FSR does wonders in some games.
